proposals.title: Nassim Nicholas Taleb
proposals.angle: Taleb's black swan framework and its influence on tail-risk hedging and fragility thinking in finance.

proposals.title: Benjamin Graham
proposals.angle: The father of value investing, margin of safety, and Security Analysis as the foundation of fundamental investing.

proposals.title: John Maynard Keynes
proposals.angle: Keynes as both macroeconomic theorist and successful speculative investor managing the King's College endowment.

proposals.title: Stanley Druckenmiller
proposals.angle: Soros's chief strategist who executed the pound trade and later built a legendary macro hedge fund record.

proposals.title: Howard Marks
proposals.angle: Oaktree's founder on market cycles, second-level thinking, and disciplined distressed-debt investing.

proposals.title: Paul Samuelson
proposals.angle: How Samuelson mathematized economics and shaped modern neoclassical synthesis.

proposals.title: Friedrich Hayek
proposals.angle: Hayek's price-signal theory and his critique of central economic planning.

proposals.title: Joseph Schumpeter
proposals.angle: Schumpeter's concept of creative destruction as the engine of capitalist growth.

proposals.title: Fischer Black
proposals.angle: Black's foundational contributions to options pricing and equilibrium asset theory.

proposals.title: Gary Becker
proposals.angle: Becker's extension of rational-choice economics to human capital and social behavior.

proposals.title: Hyman Minsky
proposals.angle: Minsky's financial-instability hypothesis explaining how stability breeds crisis.

proposals.title: Franco Modigliani
proposals.angle: Modigliani's irrelevance theorems on capital structure and his life-cycle savings model.

proposals.title: Kenneth Arrow
proposals.angle: Arrow's impossibility theorem and his general equilibrium framework with Debreu.

proposals.title: James Tobin
proposals.angle: Tobin's q ratio linking asset prices to investment and his portfolio-selection theory.

proposals.title: Irving Fisher
proposals.angle: Fisher's quantity theory of money, debt-deflation spiral, and real-versus-nominal interest distinction.

proposals.title: George Akerlof
proposals.angle: Akerlof's market-for-lemons model revealing how information asymmetry destroys markets.

proposals.title: Joseph Stiglitz
proposals.angle: Stiglitz's work on information economics, market failures, and inequality.

proposals.title: William Sharpe
proposals.angle: Sharpe's Capital Asset Pricing Model and the risk-adjusted performance ratio bearing his name.

proposals.title: Robert Mundell
proposals.angle: Mundell's optimal-currency-area theory that underpinned the design of the euro.

proposals.title: Myron Scholes
proposals.angle: Scholes's options-pricing breakthrough and his role in the rise and collapse of LTCM.

proposals.title: Robert Lucas
proposals.angle: Lucas's rational-expectations revolution and its challenge to Keynesian stabilization policy.

proposals.title: Carmen Reinhart
proposals.angle: Reinhart's cross-century empirical research on sovereign debt crises and financial collapses.

proposals.title: Janet Yellen
proposals.angle: Yellen's contributions to labor-market economics and her tenure shaping Fed policy.

proposals.title: Nouriel Roubini
proposals.angle: Roubini's pre-2008 crisis warnings and his framework for identifying macro tail risks.

proposals.title: Thomas Piketty
proposals.angle: Piketty's r-greater-than-g thesis linking capital returns to long-run wealth inequality.

proposals.title: Andrei Shleifer
proposals.angle: Shleifer's behavioral-finance research on limits to arbitrage and noise-trader risk.

proposals.title: EV/EBITDA Multiple
proposals.angle: The most widely used enterprise-value multiple for comparing capital-structure-neutral operating earnings across industries.

proposals.title: EV/EBIT Multiple
proposals.angle: An enterprise-value multiple that respects depreciation, making it fairer than EV/EBITDA for capital-heavy businesses.

proposals.title: Price-to-Sales Ratio
proposals.angle: An equity multiple anchored to top-line revenue, useful when earnings are negative or highly volatile.

proposals.title: Price-to-Cash-Flow Ratio
proposals.angle: An equity multiple using operating cash flow to sidestep accrual-accounting distortions in reported earnings.

proposals.title: Price-to-Tangible-Book Value
proposals.angle: A book-value multiple that strips intangibles and goodwill to assess what investors pay for hard assets.

proposals.title: EV/Invested Capital
proposals.angle: An enterprise-value multiple comparing market value to the total capital deployed in a business.

proposals.title: EV/NOPAT Multiple
proposals.angle: An enterprise-value multiple using net operating profit after tax to link market value with after-tax operating performance.

proposals.title: Forward P/E Ratio
proposals.angle: A price-to-earnings multiple built on consensus next-twelve-months estimates rather than reported trailing earnings.

proposals.title: Trailing P/E Ratio
proposals.angle: The classic P/E variant using the four most recently reported quarters, anchoring valuation in actual realized earnings.

proposals.title: Shiller CAPE Ratio
proposals.angle: A cyclically adjusted P/E using ten-year real average earnings to smooth out business-cycle distortions in equity valuation.

proposals.title: PEGY Ratio
proposals.angle: An extension of the PEG ratio that also adjusts for the dividend yield, capturing total return potential in one number.

proposals.title: EV/Gross Profit Multiple
proposals.angle: An enterprise-value multiple anchored to gross profit, commonly applied to software and asset-light businesses with high R&D spend.

proposals.title: EV/Revenue Growth-Adjusted Multiple (Rule of 40)
proposals.angle: A SaaS-era heuristic combining revenue growth rate and profit margin to assess whether a software company's revenue multiple is justified.

proposals.title: Price-to-Net Asset Value
proposals.angle: A multiple used for real-estate and closed-end funds comparing market price to the independently appraised net asset value.

proposals.title: Price-to-FFO Multiple
proposals.angle: The standard REIT valuation multiple replacing earnings with funds from operations to undo real-estate depreciation distortions.

proposals.title: Price-to-AFFO Multiple
proposals.angle: A refined REIT multiple that further deducts maintenance capex and straight-line rent adjustments from FFO for a truer cash picture.

proposals.title: P/B Ratio for Banks
proposals.angle: How the price-to-book multiple is applied specifically to financial institutions, where book value is the primary value anchor.

proposals.title: EV-to-Capacity Multiple
proposals.angle: An industry-specific operational multiple dividing enterprise value by physical capacity, used in mining, airlines, and utilities.

proposals.title: Multiple Expansion
proposals.angle: The phenomenon where a stock's valuation multiple rises independently of earnings, contributing to returns beyond fundamental growth.

proposals.title: Multiple Compression
proposals.angle: The contraction of a valuation multiple over time, typically driven by rising rates, slowing growth, or sector de-rating.

proposals.title: LBO Exit Multiple
proposals.angle: The assumed sale multiple applied at the end of a leveraged buyout model to calculate sponsor returns at exit.

proposals.title: Transaction Multiple
proposals.angle: Multiples derived from actual M&A deal prices, typically including a control premium above public-market trading multiples.

proposals.title: Acquirer's Multiple
proposals.angle: A value-investing metric relating enterprise value to operating earnings to identify potentially cheap acquisition targets.

proposals.title: Private Company Discount to Public Multiples
proposals.angle: The empirical markdown applied to private-company multiples to reflect illiquidity, concentrated ownership, and limited information.

proposals.title: Price-to-Distributable-Cash-Flow Multiple
proposals.angle: A valuation multiple used for MLPs and pipelines anchored to the cash available for distribution to unitholders.

proposals.title: Swing Trading
proposals.angle: Capturing multi-day to multi-week price swings by holding through overnight risk.

proposals.title: Trend Following
proposals.angle: Riding sustained directional moves by entering after a trend is confirmed, not predicted.

proposals.title: Mean Reversion Trading
proposals.angle: Betting that prices stretched away from historical averages will snap back toward them.

proposals.title: News Trading
proposals.angle: Entering positions immediately around scheduled or breaking macro and corporate announcements.

proposals.title: Pairs Trading
proposals.angle: Simultaneously buying an underperforming security and shorting a correlated one to exploit divergence.

proposals.title: Algorithmic Trading
proposals.angle: Executing orders via pre-programmed rules that remove discretion from individual trade decisions.

proposals.title: High-Frequency Trading
proposals.angle: Exploiting microsecond latency advantages to profit from tiny, fleeting price discrepancies at massive volume.

proposals.title: Momentum Trading
proposals.angle: Buying recent winners and selling recent losers on the premise that short-term trends persist.

proposals.title: Breakout Trading
proposals.angle: Entering a position when price decisively clears a key support or resistance level.

proposals.title: Contrarian Trading
proposals.angle: Deliberately fading consensus sentiment by buying when others panic and selling when others euphoric.

proposals.title: Arbitrage Trading
proposals.angle: Locking in near-riskless profit by exploiting simultaneous price differences for equivalent assets across markets.

proposals.title: Event-Driven Trading
proposals.angle: Structuring trades around discrete corporate events — mergers, spin-offs, earnings — where outcomes shift valuations sharply.

proposals.title: Range Trading
proposals.angle: Repeatedly buying at established support and selling at resistance while a market consolidates sideways.

proposals.title: Tape Reading
proposals.angle: Interpreting real-time order flow, trade size, and price action to infer institutional supply and demand.

proposals.title: Order Flow Trading
proposals.angle: Using the live stream of bids, asks, and executed orders to anticipate short-term price direction.

proposals.title: Carry Trade
proposals.angle: Borrowing in a low-interest currency to invest in a high-yield one, profiting from the rate differential.

proposals.title: Statistical Arbitrage
proposals.angle: Using quantitative models to identify and trade mean-reverting spread relationships across large baskets of securities.

proposals.title: Prudential Regulation Authority
proposals.angle: The UK body supervising banks and insurers for financial safety and soundness.

proposals.title: European Central Bank Supervisory Arm
proposals.angle: The ECB's Single Supervisory Mechanism directly oversees significant eurozone banks.

proposals.title: Bank for International Settlements
proposals.angle: The global hub for central bank cooperation and the source of Basel capital standards.

proposals.title: Financial Stability Board
proposals.angle: The G20-mandated body that monitors and makes recommendations on the global financial system.

proposals.title: IOSCO
proposals.angle: The international body setting cooperation standards among the world's securities regulators.

proposals.title: Office of Financial Research
proposals.angle: The US Treasury unit that collects data and identifies systemic risks across the financial system.

proposals.title: European Securities and Markets Authority
proposals.angle: The EU regulator with direct supervisory powers over credit rating agencies and trade repositories.

proposals.title: Securities and Futures Commission
proposals.angle: Hong Kong's independent statutory regulator of securities and futures markets.

proposals.title: Monetary Authority of Singapore
proposals.angle: Singapore's combined central bank and financial regulator overseeing all financial sectors.

proposals.title: BaFin
proposals.angle: Germany's integrated federal regulator supervising banks, insurers, and securities markets.

proposals.title: Autorité des Marchés Financiers
proposals.angle: France's independent regulator protecting savings invested in financial products and markets.

proposals.title: Securities and Exchange Board of India
proposals.angle: India's statutory regulator protecting investors and developing the securities market.

proposals.title: Office of Foreign Assets Control
proposals.angle: The US Treasury unit administering and enforcing economic and trade sanctions programs.

proposals.title: Federal Housing Finance Agency
proposals.angle: The US regulator and conservator overseeing Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and the Federal Home Loan Banks.

buckets.dir: market microstructure — order types, execution, structure, settlement/clearing, intraday phenomena, costs

proposals.title: Payment for Order Flow
proposals.angle: How brokers earn revenue by routing retail orders to market makers instead of exchanges.

proposals.title: Order Flow Internalization
proposals.angle: When a broker or dealer fills client orders in-house rather than routing them to a public venue.

proposals.title: Bid-Ask Spread
proposals.angle: The gap between best buy and sell quotes as the primary measure of market liquidity cost.

proposals.title: Market Impact Cost
proposals.angle: How a large order moves prices against the trader before it is fully executed.

proposals.title: Implementation Shortfall
proposals.angle: Measuring total execution cost as the gap between decision price and final average fill price.

proposals.title: TWAP Execution
proposals.angle: Slicing a large order into equal time-weighted tranches to minimise intraday market impact.

proposals.title: VWAP Execution
proposals.angle: Benchmarking or targeting the volume-weighted average price when executing large institutional orders.

proposals.title: Dark Pool
proposals.angle: Off-exchange private trading venues where orders are hidden until after execution.

proposals.title: Tick Size
proposals.angle: The minimum allowable price increment for a security and its effect on spread and liquidity.

proposals.title: Maker-Taker Pricing
proposals.angle: Exchange fee model that rebates liquidity providers and charges liquidity takers per share.

proposals.title: Spoofing and Layering
proposals.angle: Placing and cancelling large orders to manipulate the order book and deceive other traders.

proposals.title: Circuit Breaker and Trading Halt
proposals.angle: Automatic market-wide or single-stock pauses triggered by extreme intraday price moves.

proposals.title: Settlement Fails
proposals.angle: What happens when a seller cannot deliver securities by the settlement deadline and the consequences.

proposals.title: Continuous Market vs. Call Auction
proposals.angle: Contrasting always-on order matching with periodic batch auctions and their liquidity trade-offs.

proposals.title: Locked and Crossed Markets
proposals.angle: How bid prices equal or exceed ask prices across venues and the rules that resolve the anomaly.

proposals.title: Trade-Through Protection
proposals.angle: The Reg NMS obligation to route orders to the venue displaying the best price rather than executing locally at an inferior price.

proposals.title: Price-Time Priority
proposals.angle: The two-level queue rule — best price first, then earliest arrival — that governs order matching in continuous-auction markets.

proposals.title: Auction Imbalance Mechanism
proposals.angle: How exchanges compute and publish order-side imbalances before the open and close to attract liquidity-providing contra orders.

proposals.title: Market-on-Close Order Mechanics
proposals.angle: The cutoff rules, imbalance publications, and final print process that determine how MOC and LOC orders are filled at the closing price.

proposals.title: Odd-Lot Trading Mechanics
proposals.angle: How sub-round-lot orders are handled differently from standard 100-share lots in terms of execution priority and NBBO contribution.

proposals.title: Spoofing and Layering Mechanics
proposals.angle: The order-book manipulation technique of placing and canceling large fake orders to move price and trigger reactions from other participants.

proposals.title: Quote Stuffing
proposals.angle: The tactic of flooding an exchange with rapid-fire order submissions and cancellations to slow competitors' systems and create a latency advantage.

proposals.title: Consolidated Tape Mechanics
proposals.angle: How Tape A, B, and C trade reports are aggregated into a single real-time stream of last-sale data across all US equity venues.

proposals.title: Trade Reporting Facility
proposals.angle: The FINRA mechanism through which off-exchange and OTC equity trades are reported to the public consolidated tape within 10 seconds.

proposals.title: Short Exempt Order Flag
proposals.angle: The regulatory mark applied to short-sale orders that qualify for an exception to the alternative uptick rule during a price-test circuit trigger.

proposals.title: Fractional Share Trading Mechanics
proposals.angle: How brokers aggregate sub-share retail orders, net positions internally, and settle fractional exposure rather than routing it to exchanges.

proposals.title: Ex-Clearing Trades
proposals.angle: Large bilateral equity transactions settled directly between counterparties outside the central counterparty clearing system to reduce CCP margin costs.

proposals.title: Mandatory Quote Obligations
proposals.angle: The minimum size and maximum spread requirements that registered market makers must display continuously during core trading hours.

proposals.title: Immediate-or-Cancel vs Fill-or-Kill Mechanics
proposals.angle: How these two all-or-none immediacy instructions differ in whether partial fills are accepted and how each interacts with order-book sweep logic.

proposals.title: Order Protection Rule
proposals.angle: Reg NMS Rule 611, which prohibits trading through a protected quotation and requires inter-market sweep orders when trading at inferior prices.

proposals.title: Two-Sided Market Obligation
proposals.angle: The requirement that designated market makers post both a bid and an offer simultaneously, providing continuous liquidity in the securities they cover.

proposals.title: Percentage Lease
proposals.angle: Retail lease structure where base rent is supplemented by a share of tenant sales revenue.

proposals.title: Gross Lease
proposals.angle: Lease type where the landlord absorbs all operating expenses rather than passing them to the tenant.

proposals.title: Common Area Maintenance Charges
proposals.angle: Reconcilable operating-cost pass-throughs billed to tenants for shared building spaces.

proposals.title: Tenant Improvement Allowance
proposals.angle: Landlord-funded budget granted to tenants to customise leased space before occupancy.

proposals.title: Lease Abstraction
proposals.angle: Process of extracting key economic and legal terms from full lease documents into a summary record.

proposals.title: Rent Roll
proposals.angle: Snapshot schedule listing every tenancy, lease term, and contracted rent across a property.

proposals.title: Vacancy Rate (Property)
proposals.angle: Share of leasable space currently unoccupied, used to benchmark supply-demand balance in a market.

proposals.title: Property Management Fee
proposals.angle: Compensation structure charged by third-party managers for day-to-day building operations.

proposals.title: Operating Expense Ratio (Real Estate)
proposals.angle: Operating costs divided by gross income, measuring efficiency of a rental property's expense load.

proposals.title: Effective Gross Income
proposals.angle: Potential gross rent adjusted downward for vacancy and credit losses to reflect realistic collections.

proposals.title: Lease Renewal Option
proposals.angle: Contractual right giving a tenant the ability to extend occupancy at predetermined terms.

proposals.title: Estoppel Certificate
proposals.angle: Tenant-signed document confirming lease status and payment history, used in property sales and financing.

proposals.title: Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement
proposals.angle: Three-party instrument balancing lender, landlord, and tenant rights when a mortgage is foreclosed.

proposals.title: Capital Expenditure Reserve (Real Estate)
proposals.angle: Annual set-aside for major building repairs and replacements, distinct from routine operating costs.

proposals.title: Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust
proposals.angle: How an ILIT removes life insurance proceeds from a taxable estate while controlling distribution.

proposals.title: Charitable Remainder Trust
proposals.angle: How a CRT provides income to the donor during life then transfers remainder assets to charity.

proposals.title: Special Needs Trust
proposals.angle: How this trust preserves assets for a disabled beneficiary without disqualifying government benefits.

proposals.title: Generation-Skipping Transfer Tax
proposals.angle: The federal tax levied when wealth transfers skip a generation to grandchildren or more remote heirs.

proposals.title: Annual Gift Tax Exclusion
proposals.angle: The per-recipient annual amount one can give tax-free without eroding the lifetime exemption.

proposals.title: Step-Up in Basis
proposals.angle: How inherited assets reset their cost basis to fair market value at death, eliminating embedded capital gains.

proposals.title: Healthcare Proxy
proposals.angle: The legal document appointing someone to make medical decisions when you cannot speak for yourself.

proposals.title: Transfer-on-Death Account
proposals.angle: How TOD and POD account designations pass assets directly to named beneficiaries outside probate.

proposals.title: Guardianship Designation
proposals.angle: How parents name a preferred legal guardian for minor children within a will or separate document.

proposals.title: Joint Tenancy with Right of Survivorship
proposals.angle: How this title-holding arrangement automatically vests a deceased co-owner's share in the survivor.

proposals.title: Estate Tax Portability
proposals.angle: The election allowing a surviving spouse to use the deceased spouse's unused federal estate tax exemption.

proposals.title: Letter of Instruction
proposals.angle: The non-legal companion document that guides executors through practical tasks a formal will does not cover.

proposals.title: Digital Assets in Estate Planning
proposals.angle: How to inventory and legally transfer online accounts, cryptocurrency, and digital property at death.

proposals.title: Spendthrift Trust Provision
proposals.angle: How a spendthrift clause shields a beneficiary's trust interest from their own creditors and impulsive spending.

proposals.title: Factor Investing
proposals.angle: Systematic strategy targeting return premia tied to quantifiable characteristics like value, size, or momentum.

proposals.title: Momentum Investing
proposals.angle: Buying assets with recent strong performance on the premise that trends persist over medium horizons.

proposals.title: Contrarian Investing
proposals.angle: Deliberately trading against prevailing market sentiment to exploit overcorrection and mean reversion.

proposals.title: Sector Rotation
proposals.angle: Shifting portfolio weight across economic sectors to capture cyclically advantaged industries at each business-cycle phase.

proposals.title: Buy-and-Hold Investing
proposals.angle: Long-horizon passive ownership strategy premised on equity risk premium accrual and minimal trading costs.

proposals.title: Tactical Asset Allocation
proposals.angle: Short-term deviations from a strategic benchmark to exploit perceived mispricings across asset classes.

proposals.title: Strategic Asset Allocation
proposals.angle: Setting and maintaining a long-run target mix of asset classes aligned to an investor's risk tolerance and goals.

proposals.title: Core-Satellite Strategy
proposals.angle: Pairing a low-cost passive core with smaller active satellite positions to balance cost efficiency and alpha potential.

proposals.title: Risk Parity
proposals.angle: Allocating capital so each asset class contributes equally to total portfolio risk rather than equally in dollar terms.

proposals.title: Mean Reversion Strategy
proposals.angle: Trading on the statistical tendency of asset prices or spreads to revert toward long-run historical averages.

proposals.title: Trend Following
proposals.angle: Rules-based approach that goes long rising and short falling assets across markets, regardless of fundamental value.

proposals.title: Barbell Strategy
proposals.angle: Concentrating holdings at two extremes of risk — ultra-safe and highly speculative — while avoiding the middle.

proposals.title: Systematic Rebalancing
proposals.angle: Periodically restoring a portfolio to target weights to harvest rebalancing bonus and enforce disciplined risk control.

proposals.title: Multi-Factor Strategy
proposals.angle: Combining several distinct return factors in one portfolio to diversify factor-specific drawdown risk.

proposals.title: Velocity of Money
proposals.angle: How many times each unit of currency circulates through the economy per period.

proposals.title: Equation of Exchange
proposals.angle: Irving Fisher's MV=PT identity linking money supply, velocity, price level, and transactions.

proposals.title: Quantity Theory of Money
proposals.angle: The classical proposition that sustained price levels rise proportionally with money supply growth.

proposals.title: Endogenous Money Theory
proposals.angle: Post-Keynesian view that banks create money in response to loan demand, not central-bank supply.

proposals.title: Inside Money
proposals.angle: Bank-created money representing simultaneous assets and liabilities within the private sector.

proposals.title: Outside Money
proposals.angle: Money created by the government or central bank that is a net asset to the private sector.

proposals.title: Seigniorage
proposals.angle: Revenue a government earns by issuing currency whose face value exceeds production cost.

proposals.title: Divisia Money
proposals.angle: A weighted monetary aggregate that adjusts each component by its degree of monetary services.

proposals.title: MZM (Money Zero Maturity)
proposals.angle: A broad US money measure covering all instruments redeemable at par on demand.

proposals.title: M4 Broad Money
proposals.angle: The United Kingdom's widest official money aggregate, including non-bank private-sector holdings.

proposals.title: Broad Money vs. Narrow Money
proposals.angle: The conceptual divide between liquid hand-to-hand money and wider near-money instruments.

proposals.title: Deposit Expansion Multiplier
proposals.angle: How a single new reserve deposit cascades into a larger total increase in bank deposits.

proposals.title: Deposit Contraction
proposals.angle: The reverse multiplier process by which reserve drains shrink the total stock of bank deposits.

proposals.title: Sterilization of Monetary Flows
proposals.angle: Central bank offsetting operations that neutralize domestic money-supply effects of foreign flows.

proposals.title: Shadow Money
proposals.angle: Money-like liabilities created by non-bank financial intermediaries outside formal M-aggregate counts.

proposals.title: Currency Substitution
proposals.angle: When residents hold or transact in a foreign currency alongside or instead of the domestic one.

proposals.title: Vault Cash
proposals.angle: Physical currency held on bank premises that counts toward required reserve compliance.

proposals.title: Maker-Taker Fee Model
proposals.angle: How exchanges rebate liquidity providers and charge takers, shaping routing decisions.

proposals.title: Inverted Fee Model
proposals.angle: Venues that charge makers and rebate takers, attracting aggressive flow away from standard exchanges.

proposals.title: Market Fragmentation
proposals.angle: How equity order flow splits across dozens of venues and its effect on price discovery quality.

proposals.title: Order Internalization
proposals.angle: When broker-dealers fill client orders against their own inventory instead of routing to exchanges.

proposals.title: National Best Bid and Offer
proposals.angle: The consolidated quote across all US lit venues that brokers must reference under Reg NMS.

proposals.title: Reg NMS Order Protection Rule
proposals.angle: The US rule requiring brokers to route to any venue displaying the best protected quote.

proposals.title: Alternative Trading System
proposals.angle: SEC-regulated non-exchange venues — ECNs and dark pools — that match equity orders off-exchange.

proposals.title: Multilateral Trading Facility
proposals.angle: The EU/MiFID category of regulated non-exchange venues that compete with primary stock exchanges.

proposals.title: Systematic Internaliser
proposals.angle: MiFID II classification for broker-dealers who routinely execute client orders against own capital.

proposals.title: Continuous Trading Session
proposals.angle: The main intraday matching period between auctions where orders execute on arrival against the book.

proposals.title: Limit Order Book
proposals.angle: The data structure that queues unmatched buy and sell limit orders and governs continuous price formation.

proposals.title: Price-Time Priority
proposals.angle: The exchange matching rule that fills better-priced orders first and same-price orders in arrival order.

proposals.title: Locked and Crossed Markets
proposals.angle: Abnormal quote conditions where bids equal or exceed offers across venues, triggering regulatory responses.

proposals.title: Quote Stuffing
proposals.angle: A manipulative HFT tactic of flooding markets with rapid order messages to slow competitors' systems.

proposals.title: Spoofing and Layering
proposals.angle: Market manipulation strategies that place and cancel large orders to create false price-level impressions.

proposals.title: Colocation Services
proposals.angle: Exchange-hosted server space that gives HFT firms microsecond latency advantages over remote traders.

proposals.title: Consolidated Tape
proposals.angle: The centralised real-time stream of last-sale and quote data aggregated across all reporting venues.

proposals.title: Block Trading Facility
proposals.angle: Venue mechanisms designed to execute large institutional orders with minimal pre-trade market impact.

proposals.title: Limit Up-Limit Down Mechanism
proposals.angle: The US rule banning trades outside a price band around the recent reference price for individual stocks.

proposals.title: Trade-Through Rule
proposals.angle: The prohibition on executing a trade at a price inferior to a better quote displayed on another venue.

proposals.title: Securities Information Processor
proposals.angle: The central utility that consolidates and disseminates quote and trade data across US equity markets.

proposals.title: Market Microstructure Theory
proposals.angle: The academic framework explaining how trading rules and asymmetric information determine price formation.

proposals.title: Exchange Demutualisation
proposals.angle: The conversion of member-owned exchanges into shareholder corporations and its effect on market governance.

proposals.title: Pre-Trade Transparency
proposals.angle: Regulatory requirements to publicly display order book depth before trades execute on a venue.

proposals.title: Post-Trade Transparency
proposals.angle: Rules mandating timely public reporting of executed trade price, size, and timestamp after the fact.

proposals.title: Equity Multiplier Ratio
proposals.angle: Measures total assets funded per dollar of equity, exposing financial leverage inside the DuPont framework.

proposals.title: Debt Service Coverage Ratio
proposals.angle: Compares operating income to all debt service obligations, gauging a borrower's capacity to repay principal and interest.

proposals.title: Times Interest Earned Ratio
proposals.angle: Contrasts EBIT with interest expense to show how many times a firm can cover its interest charges from operations.

proposals.title: Net Debt to EBITDA Ratio
proposals.angle: Adjusts gross debt for cash holdings before comparing to earnings, giving a more precise leverage picture than gross-debt variants.

proposals.title: Long-Term Debt to Equity Ratio
proposals.angle: Isolates permanent, non-current borrowings against equity to assess structural capital risk independently of short-term obligations.

proposals.title: Capitalization Ratio
proposals.angle: Expresses long-term debt as a share of total capitalization, anchoring leverage analysis in the permanent funding mix.

proposals.title: Net Gearing Ratio
proposals.angle: Divides net debt by equity to show the proportion of a company's financing that comes from borrowing after netting available cash.

proposals.title: Cash Flow to Debt Ratio
proposals.angle: Relates operating cash flow to total debt, revealing how quickly a company could theoretically retire all borrowings from operations.

proposals.title: Solvency Ratio (Insurance)
proposals.angle: Measures an insurer's net income plus depreciation relative to total liabilities, gauging ability to meet long-term policyholder obligations.

proposals.title: Leverage Ratio (Basel III)
proposals.angle: The Tier 1 capital to total exposure measure mandated by Basel III to cap bank balance-sheet leverage regardless of risk weights.

proposals.title: Tangible Net Worth Ratio
proposals.angle: Strips intangibles and goodwill from equity before comparing to assets, testing solvency on a hard-asset basis.

proposals.title: Debt to Capital Ratio
proposals.angle: States total debt as a fraction of total capital (debt plus equity), providing a capital-structure snapshot for credit analysis.

proposals.title: Net Debt Ratio
proposals.angle: Compares net debt (gross debt minus cash) to total assets, refining the gross leverage picture by accounting for liquid reserves.

proposals.title: Funded Debt to EBITDA
proposals.angle: Limits the debt numerator to interest-bearing, longer-dated obligations, separating structural leverage from trade payables noise.

proposals.title: EBITDA to Interest Coverage Ratio
proposals.angle: Uses EBITDA rather than EBIT in the numerator to include depreciation add-back, common in leveraged-buyout covenant tests.

proposals.title: Debt to Tangible Assets Ratio
proposals.angle: Removes intangible assets from the denominator to assess how much hard collateral backs outstanding debt obligations.

proposals.title: Financial Leverage Ratio
proposals.angle: The ratio of average total assets to average equity, measuring how aggressively a firm amplifies returns (and risk) through borrowing.

proposals.title: Senior Debt to EBITDA
proposals.angle: Focuses only on secured, priority-ranking debt in leveraged lending, a standard covenant metric in syndicated credit agreements.

proposals.title: Total Liabilities to Equity Ratio
proposals.angle: Captures all obligations — current and non-current — relative to equity, offering a broader leverage measure than long-term-debt-only variants.

proposals.title: Adjusted Leverage Ratio
proposals.angle: Recasts reported debt for off-balance-sheet items such as operating leases and pension deficits before computing the leverage multiple.

proposals.title: Proprietary Ratio
proposals.angle: The inverse of the equity multiplier — shareholders' equity divided by total assets — indicating what fraction of assets owners truly fund.

proposals.title: Cash Coverage Ratio
proposals.angle: Adds non-cash charges back to EBIT before dividing by interest expense, assessing debt-service capacity using cash-based earnings.

proposals.title: Total Debt Service Ratio
proposals.angle: Broadens DSCR to include all contractual cash outflows — principal, interest, and lease payments — used heavily in project finance.

proposals.title: Interest Burden Ratio
proposals.angle: The DuPont component that shows how much pre-tax income survives after interest costs, linking capital structure to return on equity.

proposals.title: Book Value Leverage Ratio
proposals.angle: Uses book-value equity rather than market equity in the denominator, preferred by creditors for balance-sheet-based covenant testing.

proposals.title: Guaranteed Renewable Insurance
proposals.angle: How guaranteed renewability protects policyholders from losing coverage after a claim.

proposals.title: Indexed Universal Life Insurance
proposals.angle: How IUL ties cash-value growth to a market index while capping downside risk.

proposals.title: Insurance Deductible
proposals.angle: How the deductible shifts initial loss cost to the insured to reduce premium expense.

proposals.title: Insurance Premium Factors
proposals.angle: The actuarial and underwriting variables that determine what a personal policyholder pays.

proposals.title: Coinsurance Clause
proposals.angle: How the coinsurance requirement in property policies penalizes under-insurance at claim time.

proposals.title: Subrogation
proposals.angle: How insurers recover claim payments by stepping into the insured's right to sue a third party.

proposals.title: Insurance Policy Rider
proposals.angle: How riders add or modify coverage beyond a base policy's standard terms.

proposals.title: Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance
proposals.angle: How AD&D pays a scheduled benefit only when loss results from a qualifying accident.

proposals.title: Critical Illness Insurance
proposals.angle: How critical illness policies pay a lump sum upon diagnosis of specified serious conditions.

proposals.title: Hospital Indemnity Insurance
proposals.angle: How fixed-cash daily benefits supplement major-medical coverage during hospitalization.

proposals.title: GAP Insurance
proposals.angle: How GAP coverage pays the difference between an auto loan balance and the vehicle's actual cash value.

proposals.title: Mortgage Protection Insurance
proposals.angle: How mortgage protection life insurance pays off a home loan balance upon the borrower's death.

proposals.title: Private Mortgage Insurance
proposals.angle: How PMI protects the lender — not the borrower — on low-down-payment conventional loans.

proposals.title: Cash Value in Life Insurance
proposals.angle: How permanent life policies accumulate a tax-deferred savings component separate from the death benefit.

proposals.title: Life Settlement
proposals.angle: How policyholders sell an in-force life insurance policy to a third-party investor for more than surrender value.

proposals.title: Viatical Settlement
proposals.angle: How terminally ill policyholders sell their life insurance for immediate cash below the death benefit.

proposals.title: Free-Look Period
proposals.angle: The statutory window during which a new policyholder may cancel and receive a full premium refund.

proposals.title: Insurance Grace Period
proposals.angle: How a mandatory post-due-date window keeps a policy in force while an overdue premium is paid.

proposals.title: Incontestability Clause
proposals.angle: How the incontestability clause bars insurers from voiding a policy for misrepresentation after two years.

proposals.title: Burial Insurance
proposals.angle: How small whole-life policies are designed specifically to cover final-expense and funeral costs.

proposals.title: Flood Insurance
proposals.angle: Why standard homeowners policies exclude flood damage and how the NFIP fills the gap.

proposals.title: Earthquake Insurance
proposals.angle: How separate earthquake endorsements or policies cover structural loss excluded from standard homeowners coverage.

proposals.title: Title Insurance
proposals.angle: How owner and lender title policies protect against undisclosed claims on real property at closing.

proposals.title: Identity Theft Insurance
proposals.angle: How identity theft coverage reimburses restoration costs rather than the stolen funds themselves.

proposals.title: Personal Insurance Underwriting
proposals.angle: How underwriters assess individual risk to decide whether to issue a policy and at what premium.

proposals.title: Days Inventory Outstanding
proposals.angle: Measures how many days a firm holds inventory before selling it.

proposals.title: Revenue Per Employee
proposals.angle: Gauges workforce productivity by dividing total revenue by headcount.

proposals.title: Total Asset Turnover
proposals.angle: Assesses how efficiently all assets — current and long-term — generate sales.

proposals.title: Working Capital Turnover
proposals.angle: Shows how effectively a firm deploys net working capital to produce revenue.

proposals.title: Operating Cycle
proposals.angle: Tracks the elapsed days from raw-material purchase through cash collection from sales.

proposals.title: Accounts Payable Days
proposals.angle: Calculates the average number of days a company takes to pay its suppliers.

proposals.title: Sales to Net Working Capital Ratio
proposals.angle: Reveals whether a firm's short-term capital base is keeping pace with its sales volume.

proposals.title: Equity Turnover Ratio
proposals.angle: Measures how efficiently shareholders' equity is converted into revenue.

proposals.title: Net Asset Turnover
proposals.angle: Relates revenue to net assets (total assets minus current liabilities) as a capital-efficiency check.

proposals.title: Days Sales in Inventory
proposals.angle: Estimates how long current inventory would last given the current daily cost-of-sales rate.

proposals.title: Creditor Days Ratio
proposals.angle: Benchmarks supplier payment speed against industry norms to assess payables management.

proposals.title: Debtor Days Ratio
proposals.angle: Tracks how quickly customers settle invoices, flagging collections tightness or laxness.

proposals.title: Overhead Efficiency Ratio
proposals.angle: Compares overhead costs to revenue to expose how much top-line growth is consumed by fixed costs.

proposals.title: Cost-to-Income Ratio
proposals.angle: Bank-sector efficiency metric dividing operating costs by operating income.

proposals.title: Asset Utilization Ratio
proposals.angle: Broad measure of how much revenue each dollar of total assets generates across a business.

proposals.title: Inventory-to-Sales Ratio
proposals.angle: Signals whether stock levels are rising faster than sales, a leading indicator of demand weakness.

proposals.title: DuPont Asset Efficiency Component
proposals.angle: Isolates the asset-turnover leg of the DuPont decomposition to pinpoint operational drag.

proposals.title: Cash Conversion Efficiency
proposals.angle: Expresses the share of operating profit that converts into free cash flow over a period.

proposals.title: Capital Employed Turnover
proposals.angle: Measures how many dollars of sales each dollar of long-term capital employed produces.

proposals.title: Receivables-to-Sales Ratio
proposals.angle: Flags whether accounts receivable are growing disproportionately faster than revenue.

proposals.title: Stock-to-Sales Ratio
proposals.angle: Retail and supply-chain metric comparing on-hand inventory to monthly sales volume.

proposals.title: EUR/USD: The World's Most Traded Pair
proposals.angle: How the euro-dollar pair became the benchmark for global FX liquidity and price discovery.

proposals.title: USD/CHF: The Swissie
proposals.angle: Why the Swiss franc's safe-haven status makes USD/CHF behave inversely to risk appetite.

proposals.title: USD/CAD: The Loonie
proposals.angle: How crude oil prices and Canada-US trade flows dominate USD/CAD exchange rate movements.

proposals.title: Exotic Currency Pairs
proposals.angle: The structural features — wide spreads, thin liquidity, political risk — that define exotic FX pairs.

proposals.title: Minor Currency Pairs
proposals.angle: Cross-pairs among major currencies that exclude the US dollar and their distinct liquidity profile.

proposals.title: Currency Pair Quoting Conventions
proposals.angle: The market rules determining which currency comes first and why some pairs are inverted by convention.

proposals.title: Pip and Pipette
proposals.angle: The standardized minimum price increment in FX pairs and how it translates to monetary profit and loss.

proposals.title: Lot Size in Forex
proposals.angle: How standard, mini, and micro lots define position sizing and risk scaling in currency trading.

proposals.title: Nominal Effective Exchange Rate
proposals.angle: A trade-weighted basket measure of a currency's value against multiple partners simultaneously.

proposals.title: Real Effective Exchange Rate
proposals.angle: The inflation-adjusted trade-weighted exchange rate used to assess a country's international competitiveness.

proposals.title: Spot Exchange Rate
proposals.angle: The price for immediate currency delivery and why it forms the anchor for all other FX pricing.

proposals.title: Forward Exchange Rate
proposals.angle: How interest rate differentials between two countries mechanically set the price for future currency delivery.

proposals.title: Covered Interest Rate Parity
proposals.angle: The no-arbitrage condition linking forward exchange rates to the interest rate differential between two currencies.

proposals.title: Uncovered Interest Rate Parity
proposals.angle: The theoretical condition that expected currency depreciation should fully offset interest rate advantages.

proposals.title: Safe-Haven Currencies
proposals.angle: Why certain currencies appreciate during global stress events and the structural reasons behind flight-to-safety flows.

proposals.title: Petrocurrency
proposals.angle: Currencies whose exchange rates move closely with oil export revenues and the mechanism linking them.

proposals.title: Currency Pair Spread Determinants
proposals.angle: Why spreads vary across pairs and what liquidity, volatility, and market-making costs contribute to the gap.

proposals.title: Currency Fixing
proposals.angle: How official benchmark exchange rate fixings are set daily and their role in valuing international contracts.

proposals.title: WM/Reuters Fix
proposals.angle: The 4 pm London benchmark rate, how it is calculated, and the market manipulation scandal it triggered.

proposals.title: US Dollar Index (DXY)
proposals.angle: How the DXY basket weights six currencies against the dollar and what it reveals about broad USD strength.

proposals.title: Currency Pair Seasonality
proposals.angle: Recurring calendar patterns in FX pair returns driven by trade cycles, fiscal flows, and repatriation.

proposals.title: Inverse Currency Pair
proposals.angle: The arithmetic relationship between a direct and its reciprocal quote and how traders switch between them.

proposals.title: Currency Pair Liquidity Windows
proposals.angle: How the overlap of trading sessions determines when each pair is most actively traded and spreads tighten.

proposals.title: Currency Basket
proposals.angle: A weighted portfolio of currencies used as a reference unit for pegs, SDRs, and portfolio hedging.

proposals.title: Onshore vs Offshore Yuan: CNY and CNH
proposals.angle: How China's capital controls create two distinct exchange rates for the same currency and why they diverge.

proposals.title: Special Drawing Rights (SDR)
proposals.angle: The IMF's composite reserve asset, its basket composition, and how it functions as an international unit of account.

proposals.title: Mean Reversion in Currency Pairs
proposals.angle: The empirical tendency of exchange rates to drift toward long-run fundamental values after prolonged deviations.

proposals.title: Dual Exchange Rate
proposals.angle: When a country maintains separate official and commercial rates, why it does so, and the distortions that follow.

proposals.title: Commodity Supercycle
proposals.angle: Multi-decade boom-bust waves in broad commodity prices driven by industrialization demand surges.

proposals.title: Spot Price vs. Futures Price
proposals.angle: How the gap between immediate delivery price and futures contract price signals market expectations.

proposals.title: Physical Commodity Delivery
proposals.angle: Mechanics of taking or making actual delivery of a commodity at futures contract expiry.

proposals.title: Commodity Warehousing
proposals.angle: How exchange-licensed warehouses store deliverable grades and influence futures basis.

proposals.title: Strategic Stockpile
proposals.angle: Government-held reserves of critical commodities maintained to buffer supply shocks or military need.

proposals.title: Commodity Price Index
proposals.angle: Weighted benchmarks such as CRB and GSCI that track broad or sector-specific commodity price levels.

proposals.title: Commodity Seasonality
proposals.angle: Recurring annual price patterns in commodities driven by harvest cycles, weather, and demand rhythms.

proposals.title: Grade and Quality Specifications
proposals.angle: How standardized purity or quality grades define deliverable supply and create basis differentials.

proposals.title: Commodity Producer Hedging
proposals.angle: How miners, farmers, and drillers lock in forward prices to reduce revenue uncertainty.

proposals.title: Resource Curse
proposals.angle: Paradox where commodity-rich economies underperform due to Dutch Disease and institutional dysfunction.

proposals.title: Commodity Trading House
proposals.angle: Privately held firms like Glencore and Vitol that dominate global physical commodity flows.

proposals.title: Freight Rates and Commodity Markets
proposals.angle: How bulk shipping costs, tracked by the Baltic Dry Index, shape delivered commodity prices.

proposals.title: Commodity Market Manipulation
proposals.angle: Corner, squeeze, and spoofing tactics used to distort commodity prices and regulatory responses.

proposals.title: Certified Emission Reduction
proposals.angle: Carbon credits issued under Kyoto CDM that function as tradable environmental commodities.

proposals.title: Universal Basic Income
proposals.angle: How UBI differs from targeted transfers and what pilot experiments reveal about labor-supply effects.

proposals.title: Negative Income Tax
proposals.angle: Milton Friedman's proposal to replace fragmented welfare with a single phase-out subsidy below a threshold.

proposals.title: Means-Testing
proposals.angle: How income and asset screens target transfers to the poor while creating welfare cliffs and administrative costs.

proposals.title: Welfare Cliff
proposals.angle: The implicit marginal tax rate spike where benefit phase-outs create disincentives to increase earnings.

proposals.title: Conditional Cash Transfer
proposals.angle: Programs like Bolsa Família that tie payments to education or health-check compliance to build human capital.

proposals.title: Housing Choice Voucher
proposals.angle: Demand-side rental subsidies that let recipients choose private-market units rather than live in public housing.

proposals.title: Unemployment Insurance
proposals.angle: Payroll-financed temporary income replacement and its role as an automatic stabiliser during downturns.

proposals.title: Disability Insurance
proposals.angle: Government insurance replacing earnings when workers become unable to work due to long-term impairment.

proposals.title: Pay-As-You-Go Pension
proposals.angle: How PAYG schemes fund current retirees from active workers' contributions, creating intergenerational fiscal risk.

proposals.title: Social Insurance
proposals.angle: The contributory framework distinguishing social insurance from pure welfare and the actuarial tensions it raises.

proposals.title: In-Kind Transfer
proposals.angle: Non-cash government benefits such as food or medical care and the efficiency debate versus direct cash grants.

proposals.title: Benefit Notch
proposals.angle: A sharp discrete drop in total benefit value at a specific income threshold, contrasted with smooth phase-outs.

proposals.title: Categorical Eligibility
proposals.angle: How demographic or status-based criteria—age, veteran status, disability—gate access to transfer programs.

proposals.title: Take-Up Rate
proposals.angle: The fraction of eligible households that actually claim a benefit, and why administrative barriers suppress it.

buckets.dir: market microstructure — order types, execution, structure, settlement/clearing, intraday phenomena, costs

proposals.title: Good Till Cancelled Order
proposals.angle: A resting limit order that persists across sessions until the trader explicitly cancels it.

proposals.title: Day Order
proposals.angle: An order that automatically expires at the end of the trading session if unfilled.

proposals.title: Good Till Date Order
proposals.angle: A time-limited order that remains active until a trader-specified calendar date.

proposals.title: Immediate or Cancel Order
proposals.angle: An order executed instantly for whatever quantity is available, with any remainder cancelled.

proposals.title: Market on Close Order
proposals.angle: An order guaranteed to execute at the official closing auction price of the session.

proposals.title: Market on Open Order
proposals.angle: An order routed to the opening auction so it executes at the day's official opening price.

proposals.title: Limit on Close Order
proposals.angle: A closing-auction order that executes only if the closing price meets the specified limit.

proposals.title: Limit on Open Order
proposals.angle: An opening-auction order that fills only if the opening price satisfies the limit condition.

proposals.title: One Cancels Other Order
proposals.angle: A paired order where execution of either leg automatically cancels the remaining leg.

proposals.title: Bracket Order
proposals.angle: A three-legged order combining an entry with a simultaneous profit target and stop loss.

proposals.title: Reserve Order
proposals.angle: An exchange mechanism that shows only a small visible quantity while a hidden reserve refreshes it.

proposals.title: Minimum Quantity Order
proposals.angle: An order that executes only if an initial fill meets a trader-specified minimum share threshold.

proposals.title: Intermarket Sweep Order
proposals.angle: A Reg NMS order type that sweeps multiple venues simultaneously, bypassing the NBBO protection obligation.

proposals.title: Dark Limit Order
proposals.angle: A non-displayed limit order resting in a dark pool or hidden book with price priority.

proposals.title: Primary Peg Order
proposals.angle: An order pegged to the same-side best quote, ensuring it never crosses the national best bid or offer.

proposals.title: Market Peg Order
proposals.angle: An order pegged to the opposite-side best quote, aggressively tracking the far touch of the spread.

proposals.title: Conditional Order
proposals.angle: An indication-of-interest order that converts to a live order only when matching contra interest is found.

proposals.title: Not-Held Order
proposals.angle: An instruction granting the broker discretion over timing and price without the client holding them liable.

proposals.title: Odd Lot Order
proposals.angle: An order for fewer than the standard round-lot size, historically subject to different routing and pricing rules.

proposals.title: Cross Order
proposals.angle: A broker-facilitated transaction matching a buy and sell from different clients at an agreed price.

proposals.title: Basis Order
proposals.angle: An order for a stock basket priced at a fixed spread to an index or futures benchmark rather than market.

proposals.title: TWAP Order
proposals.angle: An execution algorithm slicing a large order into equal time-weighted tranches to match the time-weighted average price.

proposals.title: Guaranteed VWAP Order
proposals.angle: A broker commitment to fill a client order at the day's volume-weighted average price, absorbing tracking risk.

proposals.title: Stop on Quote Order
proposals.angle: A stop order that triggers on a firm exchange quote rather than a last-sale print, reducing false triggers.

proposals.title: Auction Limit Order
proposals.angle: A limit order eligible only for participation in a scheduled opening, closing, or intraday auction.

proposals.title: Petrodollar System
proposals.angle: How oil-denominated dollar recycling reshaped global capital flows after 1973.

proposals.title: Securitization Revolution
proposals.angle: The structural transformation of lending when illiquid loans became tradeable securities.

proposals.title: Big Bang Deregulation 1986
proposals.angle: How the UK's overnight market liberalisation rewired London as a global financial centre.

proposals.title: Rise of Institutional Investors
proposals.angle: How pension funds and mutual funds displaced households as the dominant equity owners.

proposals.title: Dollar Hegemony
proposals.angle: The structural reasons the US dollar retained reserve-currency status after Bretton Woods collapsed.

proposals.title: Disintermediation of Banking
proposals.angle: How capital markets bypassed commercial banks as the primary channel for corporate finance.

proposals.title: Shadow Banking Rise
proposals.angle: How non-bank credit intermediaries grew to rival regulated banks in size and systemic importance.

proposals.title: Derivatives Market Expansion
proposals.angle: The post-1970s explosion of exchange-traded and OTC derivatives as a structural feature of modern finance.

proposals.title: Electronic Trading Transition
proposals.angle: The decades-long replacement of floor traders and telephone brokers by electronic matching engines.

proposals.title: Emerging Market Integration
proposals.angle: How developing economies joined global capital markets and absorbed foreign portfolio flows from the 1990s.

proposals.title: Private Equity Ascent
proposals.angle: The structural shift from public to private ownership as leveraged buyout financing matured after the 1980s.

proposals.title: Quantitative Easing Era
proposals.angle: How large-scale central bank asset purchases became a standard post-crisis policy tool after 2008.

proposals.title: Zero Interest Rate Era
proposals.angle: The decade-plus period of near-zero policy rates and its lasting distortions to asset pricing and capital allocation.

proposals.title: Index Fund Revolution
proposals.angle: The structural shift from active stock-picking to passive index ownership and its effect on price discovery.

proposals.title: Floating Exchange Rate Regime
proposals.angle: How the post-Bretton Woods world settled on managed floating rather than fixed pegs as the dominant exchange-rate system.

proposals.title: European Monetary Union
proposals.angle: The structural creation of a shared currency area without a shared fiscal authority and its inherent tensions.

proposals.title: China Global Financial Integration
proposals.angle: How China's entry into world trade and capital markets restructured global imbalances from the 1990s onward.

proposals.title: Junk Bond Market Creation
proposals.angle: How Michael Milken's high-yield innovations opened capital markets to below-investment-grade borrowers in the 1970s–80s.

proposals.title: Shareholder Value Movement
proposals.angle: The ideological and structural shift that made maximising shareholder returns the dominant corporate objective.

proposals.title: Great Moderation
proposals.angle: The two-decade reduction in macroeconomic volatility from the mid-1980s and the structural explanations proposed for it.

proposals.title: Regulatory Capital Arbitrage
proposals.angle: How banks structurally migrated risk off their balance sheets to exploit gaps between economic and regulatory capital rules.

proposals.title: Marginal Value at Risk
proposals.angle: Measures how adding a small position changes a portfolio's overall VaR.

proposals.title: Component Value at Risk
proposals.angle: Decomposes total portfolio VaR into each holding's standalone risk contribution.

proposals.title: Tail Dependence Coefficient
proposals.angle: Quantifies the probability that two assets crash simultaneously in extreme events.

proposals.title: Copula Risk Modeling
proposals.angle: Uses copula functions to capture non-linear dependence between asset losses.

proposals.title: Risk Contribution Decomposition
proposals.angle: Attributes total portfolio risk to individual positions using Euler's homogeneity theorem.

proposals.title: Maximum Drawdown
proposals.angle: Captures the largest peak-to-trough loss as a standalone risk measure for portfolios.

proposals.title: Calmar Ratio
proposals.angle: Relates annualized return to maximum drawdown to assess risk-adjusted performance.

proposals.title: Omega Ratio
proposals.angle: Measures the probability-weighted ratio of gains to losses above a threshold return.

proposals.title: Spectral Risk Measure
proposals.angle: Generalizes expected shortfall by weighting tail losses according to investor risk aversion.

proposals.title: Distortion Risk Measure
proposals.angle: Transforms the loss probability distribution using a distortion function to price tail risk.

proposals.title: Coherent Risk Measure
proposals.angle: Defines the axiomatic properties (subadditivity, monotonicity, homogeneity) a valid risk measure must satisfy.

proposals.title: Semi-Variance
proposals.angle: Measures downside volatility by squaring only below-mean or below-target returns.

proposals.title: Lower Partial Moment
proposals.angle: Generalizes semi-variance by raising downside deviations to any chosen order.

proposals.title: Modified Value at Risk
proposals.angle: Adjusts parametric VaR for skewness and excess kurtosis using the Cornish-Fisher expansion.

proposals.title: Risk Factor Sensitivity
proposals.angle: Measures how portfolio value changes for a unit shift in each underlying market risk factor.

proposals.title: Loss Given Default
proposals.angle: Estimates the fraction of an exposure actually lost when a borrower defaults.

proposals.title: Probability of Default
proposals.angle: Estimates the likelihood a borrower will fail to meet obligations over a defined horizon.

proposals.title: Exposure at Default
proposals.angle: Measures the outstanding credit exposure at the moment a counterparty defaults.

proposals.title: VaR Backtesting
proposals.angle: Validates VaR models by comparing predicted loss thresholds against realized trading losses.

proposals.title: Kupiec Proportion-of-Failures Test
proposals.angle: Tests whether a VaR model's exception rate is statistically consistent with its confidence level.

proposals.title: Christoffersen Interval Forecast Test
proposals.angle: Checks both the frequency and independence of VaR violations over a backtesting window.

proposals.title: Tracking Error Volatility
proposals.angle: Measures the standard deviation of a portfolio's returns relative to its benchmark.

proposals.title: Risk-Adjusted Return on Capital
proposals.angle: Scales a business line's profit by the economic capital allocated to absorb its losses.

proposals.title: Conditional Drawdown at Risk
proposals.angle: Averages the worst drawdowns beyond a threshold, treating drawdown as a coherent risk measure.

proposals.title: Systemic Risk Measure
proposals.angle: Quantifies an institution's contribution to financial-system-wide losses during market stress.

proposals.title: IPO Pricing Mechanism
proposals.angle: How underwriters set the final offer price from the bookbuild range to the public.

proposals.title: Greenshoe Option
proposals.angle: The overallotment option that lets underwriters stabilise a new issue's post-listing price.

proposals.title: Stabilisation Trading
proposals.angle: Post-IPO underwriter open-market purchases that smooth the share price in the aftermarket.

proposals.title: Rights Issue
proposals.angle: A renounceable offer of new shares to existing holders at a discount to defend ownership pro-rata.

proposals.title: Accelerated Bookbuild
proposals.angle: An overnight institutional placement that raises equity without a full roadshow or prospectus.

proposals.title: Bought Deal
proposals.angle: An offering where the underwriter purchases the entire block from the issuer before reselling it.

proposals.title: Best-Efforts Offering
proposals.angle: An underwriting structure where the bank sells as many shares as possible without guaranteeing proceeds.

proposals.title: Firm Commitment Underwriting
proposals.angle: The standard IPO arrangement in which the syndicate buys all offered shares and bears residual risk.

proposals.title: Underwriting Syndicate
proposals.angle: The group of banks that jointly distributes a large equity offering and shares the underwriting risk.

proposals.title: Prospectus
proposals.angle: The legally required disclosure document that accompanies a public equity offering to potential investors.

proposals.title: Red Herring Prospectus
proposals.angle: A preliminary prospectus filed before pricing that omits the final offer price and share count.

proposals.title: Shelf Registration
proposals.angle: An SEC mechanism letting issuers register securities in advance and sell them in tranches over time.

proposals.title: Regulation A+ Offering

proposals.title: Regulation D Offering

proposals.title: Equity Crowdfunding Offering

proposals.title: SPAC IPO
proposals.angle: The initial blank-cheque offering that capitalises a SPAC before any acquisition target is identified.

proposals.title: Tender Offer
proposals.angle: A public invitation for shareholders to sell or exchange their shares at a specified price within a deadline.

proposals.title: Block Trade
proposals.angle: A privately negotiated sale of a large shareholding outside the open market, typically via a broker.

proposals.title: Registered Direct Offering
proposals.angle: A hybrid structure placing shares with select institutions using an existing shelf registration without a public roadshow.

proposals.title: Warrant Offering
proposals.angle: The issuance of standalone warrants giving holders the right to buy new shares at a fixed exercise price.

proposals.title: Standby Underwriting
proposals.angle: An arrangement where underwriters commit to subscribe any unexercised rights in a rights issue.

proposals.title: Clawback Provision
proposals.angle: An IPO allocation clause that transfers shares from institutional to retail tranches if public demand is strong.

proposals.title: Cornerstone Investor
proposals.angle: An anchor institution that commits to a fixed IPO allocation pre-listing in exchange for a lock-up period.

proposals.title: Directed Share Program
proposals.angle: An IPO carve-out reserving shares at the offer price for employees, customers, or other designated individuals.

proposals.title: Dual-Track Process
proposals.angle: Running an IPO preparation and a private M&A sale simultaneously to maximise a seller's exit optionality.

proposals.title: Quiet Period
proposals.angle: The SEC-mandated window after an IPO filing during which issuer communications to the public are restricted.

proposals.title: Flowback Risk
proposals.angle: The selling pressure on a share price when foreign or dissenting shareholders unwind positions after a cross-border deal.

proposals.title: Spin-Off IPO
proposals.angle: An equity carve-out where a parent lists a subsidiary minority stake via a public offering rather than a distribution.

proposals.title: John Neff

proposals.title: Michael Price

proposals.title: David Dreman

proposals.title: Irving Kahn

proposals.title: Walter Schloss

proposals.title: Martin Whitman
proposals.angle: Third Avenue founder who focused on safe-and-cheap assets in distressed and overlooked securities.

proposals.title: Joel Greenblatt
proposals.angle: Gotham Capital founder and creator of the Magic Formula ranking stocks by earnings yield and ROIC.

proposals.title: Bill Miller
proposals.angle: Legg Mason manager who beat the S&P 500 fifteen consecutive years before a dramatic reversal.

proposals.title: Mohnish Pabrai
proposals.angle: Concentrated value investor who clones Buffett's methods and systematically tracks his own mistakes.

proposals.title: François Rochon
proposals.angle: Quebec-based concentrated investor who blends Graham fundamentals with qualitative moat analysis.

proposals.title: Li Lu
proposals.angle: Himalaya Capital founder and Munger-endorsed investor who pioneered deep-value investing in Asia.

proposals.title: Prem Watsa
proposals.angle: Fairfax Financial chairman known as Canada's Buffett for pairing insurance float with value equity picks.

proposals.title: Irving Fisher
