proposals.title: John Train
proposals.angle: Author of The Money Masters who documented the methods of ten great investors and shaped a generation.

proposals.title: Templeton's Contrarian Methodology
proposals.angle: How Templeton systematically bought at points of maximum pessimism to find global bargains.

proposals.title: Edward Thorp
proposals.angle: Mathematician who applied card-counting probability to warrant arbitrage and early quant hedge funds.

proposals.title: Ralph Wanger
proposals.angle: Acorn Fund manager who specialized in small-cap growth with a narrative, theme-driven approach.

proposals.title: Shelby Cullom Davis
proposals.angle: Insurance-stock specialist who built a fortune from $50,000 by concentrating in undervalued insurers.

proposals.title: John Bogle
proposals.angle: Vanguard founder who built the first retail index fund and became the industry's fiercest cost crusader.

proposals.title: T. Rowe Price Jr.
proposals.angle: Pioneer of growth-stock investing who argued quality companies compound better than cheap ones.

proposals.title: Nick Sleep
proposals.angle: Nomad Partnership manager whose scale-economy-shared thesis generated exceptional long-run returns.

proposals.title: David Abrams
proposals.angle: Low-turnover, concentrated value manager whose Boston fund compounded quietly for two decades.

proposals.title: Chuck Akre
proposals.angle: Akre Capital founder who built his framework around the three-legged stool of compounders.

proposals.title: Tom Russo
proposals.angle: Gardner Russo partner who specialises in global consumer brands with reinvestment capacity.

proposals.title: Wally Weitz
proposals.angle: Omaha-based value manager whose private-owner mindset emphasises business quality over price alone.

proposals.title: Robert Vinall
proposals.angle: European-based concentrated compounder investor known for letters critiquing sell-side short-termism.

proposals.title: Sir James Goldsmith
proposals.angle: Activist raider of the 1980s who pioneered greenmail and leveraged corporate breakup strategies.

proposals.title: Central Counterparty Clearing
proposals.angle: How a CCP interposes itself between buyer and seller to eliminate bilateral counterparty risk.

proposals.title: Central Securities Depository
proposals.angle: The infrastructure layer that immobilises physical securities and records book-entry ownership transfers.

proposals.title: Payment Versus Delivery
proposals.angle: The settlement principle ensuring a securities transfer occurs only if the cash leg simultaneously clears.

proposals.title: Trade Repository
proposals.angle: Regulated data warehouses that aggregate OTC derivatives transaction reports for systemic-risk surveillance.

proposals.title: Multilateral Trading Facility
proposals.angle: Europe's MiFID-defined alternative venue where multiple parties trade without the operator taking principal risk.

proposals.title: Designated Contract Market
proposals.angle: CFTC-licensed US exchange authorised to list futures and options for trading by retail and institutional participants.

proposals.title: Self-Regulatory Organisation
proposals.angle: Industry bodies like FINRA that exercise delegated governmental authority to write and enforce member conduct rules.

proposals.title: Index Provider
proposals.angle: Firms such as MSCI and FTSE Russell whose methodologies govern trillions in passive investment mandates.

proposals.title: Global Custodian
proposals.angle: Banks that safekeep cross-border securities, manage corporate actions, and co-ordinate a network of sub-custodians.

proposals.title: Prime Broker
proposals.angle: The bundled financing, securities-lending, and operational hub that hedge funds rely on for leveraged strategies.

proposals.title: Nostro and Vostro Accounts
proposals.angle: Correspondent-banking account pairs that allow banks to hold foreign-currency balances and settle cross-border payments.

proposals.title: Sovereign Wealth Fund
proposals.angle: State-owned investment pools that deploy national surpluses across global asset classes with long-horizon mandates.

proposals.title: Development Finance Institution
proposals.angle: Government-backed lenders that channel capital into emerging-market infrastructure and private-sector projects.

proposals.title: National Development Bank
proposals.angle: State-owned banks that finance domestic industrial policy, infrastructure, and long-term economic transformation goals.

proposals.title: Long Straddle
proposals.angle: Buying both a call and put at the same strike to profit from large moves in either direction.

proposals.title: Short Straddle
proposals.angle: Selling both a call and put at the same strike to collect premium when price stays flat.

proposals.title: Long Strangle
proposals.angle: Buying out-of-the-money call and put at different strikes for cheaper volatility exposure than a straddle.

proposals.title: Short Strangle
proposals.angle: Selling OTM call and put to earn premium with a wider breakeven band than a short straddle.

proposals.title: Covered Call
proposals.angle: Selling a call against a long stock position to generate income while capping upside.

proposals.title: Protective Put
proposals.angle: Buying a put against a long stock position to define maximum downside loss.

proposals.title: Jade Lizard
proposals.angle: Combining a short put with a short call spread so total premium collected exceeds the call spread width.

proposals.title: Reverse Jade Lizard
proposals.angle: Combining a short call with a short put spread so total credit eliminates upside risk entirely.

proposals.title: Christmas Tree Spread
proposals.angle: A three-strike extension of a butterfly where one wing is split across two further-out strikes.

proposals.title: Condor Spread
proposals.angle: Four-legged spread using four different strikes that profits when the underlying stays in a wide range.

proposals.title: Broken Wing Butterfly
proposals.angle: An asymmetric butterfly with unequal wing widths that eliminates risk on one side in exchange for a credit.

proposals.title: Skip-Strike Butterfly
proposals.angle: A butterfly variant that skips one strike between the body and one wing to create directional bias.

proposals.title: Double Diagonal Spread
proposals.angle: Selling near-term OTM options and buying further-dated OTM options on both sides simultaneously.

proposals.title: Call Backspread
proposals.angle: Selling fewer ATM calls and buying more OTM calls to profit from explosive upside moves.

proposals.title: Put Backspread
proposals.angle: Selling fewer ATM puts and buying more OTM puts to benefit from sharp downside moves.

proposals.title: Reverse Calendar Spread
proposals.angle: Buying the near-term option and selling the longer-dated one to profit from an imminent volatility spike.

proposals.title: Double Calendar Spread
proposals.angle: Placing calendar spreads at two different strikes simultaneously to widen the profit tent.

proposals.title: Synthetic Covered Call
proposals.angle: Replicating a covered call using long deep-in-the-money call plus short OTM call without holding shares.

proposals.title: Risk Reversal
proposals.angle: Simultaneously buying an OTM call and selling an OTM put to gain directional exposure at low net premium.

proposals.title: Fence Strategy
proposals.angle: A three-legged collar variant that uses a short OTM call, long ATM put, and long underlying to define a payoff range.

proposals.title: Long Combo
proposals.angle: Buying an OTM call and selling an OTM put to create leveraged bullish exposure with little or no net premium.

proposals.title: Short Combo
proposals.angle: Selling an OTM call and buying an OTM put to create leveraged bearish exposure with little net premium.

proposals.title: Strap Strategy
proposals.angle: Buying two calls and one put at the same strike to bet on a large move with upside bias.

proposals.title: Strip Strategy
proposals.angle: Buying two puts and one call at the same strike to bet on a large move with downside bias.

proposals.title: Split-Strike Synthetic
proposals.angle: A synthetic long stock using options at different strikes to reduce cost at the expense of a gap risk zone.

proposals.title: Wheel Strategy
proposals.angle: Rotating between cash-secured puts and covered calls on the same underlying to generate continuous premium income.

proposals.title: Gamma Scalping
proposals.angle: Dynamically delta-hedging a long options position to harvest realized volatility when it exceeds implied volatility.

proposals.title: Volatility Spread
proposals.angle: Any option combination structured expressly to isolate and trade the spread between implied and realized volatility.

proposals.title: Securities Act of 1933 Enactment
proposals.angle: How Congress's first federal securities law imposed mandatory disclosure to end fraudulent stock sales.

proposals.title: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 Enactment
proposals.angle: How the 1934 law created the SEC and established ongoing reporting obligations for public companies.

proposals.title: Investment Company Act of 1940 Enactment
proposals.angle: How this New Deal-era law set the governance and disclosure rules that still define mutual funds today.

proposals.title: Basel I Capital Accord Adoption
proposals.angle: How the 1988 Basel Accord created the first internationally agreed minimum bank capital ratio.

proposals.title: MiFID I Implementation
proposals.angle: How the 2007 Markets in Financial Instruments Directive dismantled exchange monopolies across Europe.

proposals.title: Commodity Futures Modernization Act Passage
proposals.angle: How the 2000 law exempted OTC derivatives from oversight and set the stage for the 2008 crisis.

proposals.title: FIRREA Passage
proposals.angle: How the 1989 Financial Institutions Reform Act dismantled the thrift industry after the S&L collapse.

proposals.title: JOBS Act Passage
proposals.angle: How the 2012 law reopened public markets to small companies by loosening IPO and crowdfunding rules.

proposals.title: Short-Selling Ban of 2008
proposals.angle: How regulators in the US and Europe imposed emergency bans on financial-stock short sales during the crisis.

proposals.title: Regulation Best Interest Adoption
proposals.angle: How the SEC's 2019 rule replaced the suitability standard with a stricter best-interest obligation for brokers.

proposals.title: Plaza Accord Signing
proposals.angle: How the 1985 G5 agreement at the Plaza Hotel engineered a coordinated dollar depreciation.

proposals.title: FATF Creation
proposals.angle: How the G7's 1989 task force built the global anti-money-laundering framework still enforced today.

proposals.title: Uptick Rule Elimination
proposals.angle: How the SEC's 2007 removal of the 1938 short-sale restriction triggered fierce debate after the 2008 crisis.

proposals.title: Basel II Framework Adoption
proposals.angle: How the 2004 Basel II accord introduced risk-sensitive internal models, replacing Basel I's blunt ratios.

proposals.title: Tracking Stock
proposals.angle: A share class whose value tracks a subsidiary or division rather than the whole company.

proposals.title: Blank Check Preferred
proposals.angle: Authorized preferred stock whose terms the board may set at issuance without shareholder approval.

proposals.title: PIK Preferred Stock
proposals.angle: Preferred shares that pay dividends in additional shares rather than cash, deferring cash outflows.

proposals.title: Trust Preferred Securities
proposals.angle: Hybrid instruments issued by a bank-sponsored trust that blend debt tax treatment with Tier 1 capital credit.

proposals.title: Auction Rate Preferred
proposals.angle: Preferred stock whose dividend rate resets periodically via a Dutch auction among existing holders.

proposals.title: Exchangeable Preferred Stock
proposals.angle: Preferred stock the issuer may swap for debt securities at its option on specified terms.

proposals.title: Fixed-to-Floating Preferred
proposals.angle: Preferred stock that pays a fixed dividend for a set period, then resets to a floating benchmark rate.

proposals.title: Deferred Shares
proposals.angle: Shares that rank behind ordinary shares for dividends and capital, often used to restructure founder economics.

proposals.title: Alphabet Shares
proposals.angle: Separate share classes labeled A, B, C and so on, allowing flexible dividend allocation among different shareholders.

proposals.title: Profit Interest Units
proposals.angle: LLC equity class that entitles holders to a share of future appreciation only, without immediate taxable income.

proposals.title: Stapled Securities
proposals.angle: Two or more securities permanently bound together and traded as one unit, common in Australian listed trusts.

proposals.title: Phantom Stock Plan
proposals.angle: A cash-settled incentive that mirrors share value appreciation without issuing actual equity to participants.

proposals.title: Authorized but Unissued Shares
proposals.angle: Shares approved in the charter but not yet sold, representing potential future dilution for existing shareholders.

proposals.title: Sunset Provision
proposals.angle: A charter clause that automatically collapses super-voting shares to one-share-one-vote after a trigger event.

proposals.title: Full Ratchet Anti-Dilution
proposals.angle: An anti-dilution mechanism that reprices preferred to the lowest subsequent issuance price regardless of round size.

proposals.title: Broad-Based Weighted Average
proposals.angle: The most founder-friendly anti-dilution formula, averaging new and old prices weighted by all dilutive securities.

proposals.title: Narrow-Based Weighted Average
proposals.angle: A weighted-average anti-dilution formula that counts only issued preferred shares, producing a sharper reset than broad-based.

proposals.title: Restricted Voting Shares
proposals.angle: Shares with a fractional vote per share rather than zero votes, maintaining partial influence for public shareholders.

proposals.title: Multiple Voting Shares
proposals.angle: Shares carrying more than one vote each, the Canadian and European equivalent of US high-vote stock.

proposals.title: Redeemable Ordinary Shares
proposals.angle: Common shares that can be bought back by the company at a predetermined price, used mainly in UK private companies.

proposals.title: Management Shares
proposals.angle: A share class reserved for company founders or managers carrying disproportionate voting control at incorporation.

proposals.title: Series Seed Preferred
proposals.angle: A simplified preferred share class used in early-stage startup financings before a full Series A round.

proposals.title: Simple Agreement for Future Equity
proposals.angle: A convertible instrument that grants rights to future equity on a priced round without accruing interest or a maturity date.

proposals.title: Shadow Equity Plan
proposals.angle: A notional ownership scheme for private-company employees that mirrors equity economics without conferring legal ownership.

proposals.title: Non-Participating Preferred
proposals.angle: Preferred stock that receives its liquidation preference but does not share further in remaining proceeds alongside common.

proposals.title: Series Preferred Stack
proposals.angle: The layered hierarchy of multiple preferred series in a venture-backed company and how seniority is determined at exit.

proposals.title: Dividend Access Share
proposals.angle: A special share issued by an Australian subsidiary to route franked dividends directly to overseas parent shareholders.

proposals.title: Ratchet Preferred
proposals.angle: Preferred stock whose conversion ratio increases automatically if performance targets or IPO price thresholds are missed.

proposals.title: Business Cycle Rotation
proposals.angle: Mapping equity sector weights to the four phases of the economic cycle.

proposals.title: Factor Rotation
proposals.angle: Systematically shifting exposure among equity factors as macro conditions change.

proposals.title: Fixed-Income Rotation
proposals.angle: Shifting duration, credit quality, or bond-sector weights in response to rate cycles.

proposals.title: Currency Rotation
proposals.angle: Reallocating across currency blocs or currency-hedged sleeves based on macro signals.

proposals.title: Commodity Sector Rotation
proposals.angle: Moving between energy, metals, and agricultural commodities as macro regimes shift.

proposals.title: Inter-Asset-Class Rotation
proposals.angle: Dynamically reweighting equities, bonds, real assets, and cash across market regimes.

proposals.title: Tactical Asset Allocation Rotation
proposals.angle: Short-term deviations from strategic weights driven by valuation and momentum signals.

proposals.title: Relative Strength Rotation
proposals.angle: Rotating into the highest-ranked assets by relative price strength against a universe.

proposals.title: Yield Curve Rotation
proposals.angle: Repositioning bond duration as the slope between short and long rates shifts.

proposals.title: Risk-On Risk-Off Rotation
proposals.angle: Switching between high-beta and safe-haven assets driven by investor risk appetite.

proposals.title: Industry Group Rotation
proposals.angle: Rotating at the industry-group level below broad sectors for finer cycle positioning.

proposals.title: Volatility Regime Rotation
proposals.angle: Adjusting strategy exposure as markets transition between low- and high-volatility regimes.

proposals.title: Inflation Regime Rotation
proposals.angle: Shifting allocations between inflation-sensitive and nominal assets as inflation trends change.

proposals.title: Earnings Revision Rotation
proposals.angle: Rotating into sectors or stocks where analyst earnings estimates are being revised upward.

proposals.title: Collective Action Clause
proposals.angle: How a bond contract provision lets a supermajority of creditors bind holdouts to a restructuring.

proposals.title: Holdout Creditors
proposals.angle: Bondholders who refuse debt exchanges and pursue full repayment through litigation, complicating sovereign restructurings.

proposals.title: London Club
proposals.angle: The informal creditor group that renegotiates sovereign commercial bank debt outside official government channels.

proposals.title: Original Sin (Sovereign Debt)
proposals.angle: Why emerging-market governments struggle to borrow internationally in their own currency, amplifying default risk.

proposals.title: Sovereign Debt Overhang
proposals.angle: How an excessive debt stock suppresses investment and growth by transferring future returns to creditors.

proposals.title: Sudden Stop
proposals.angle: The abrupt reversal of capital inflows that triggers liquidity crises and forces sovereign adjustment.

proposals.title: Debt Sustainability Analysis
proposals.angle: The IMF and World Bank framework for projecting whether a government's debt path remains solvent under stress.

proposals.title: Pari Passu Clause
proposals.angle: The sovereign bond covenant requiring equal treatment of creditors, famously weaponised in Argentina's default litigation.

proposals.title: IMF Conditionality
proposals.angle: The policy reforms a borrowing government must implement in exchange for IMF programme disbursements.

proposals.title: HIPC Initiative
proposals.angle: The multilateral programme that wrote down heavily indebted poor countries' debts to sustainable levels from 1996 onward.

proposals.title: GDP-Linked Bonds
proposals.angle: Sovereign instruments whose coupon or principal tracks economic output, sharing default risk with creditors.

proposals.title: Sovereign Debt Contagion
proposals.angle: How a single sovereign default spreads borrowing stress to unrelated countries through investor panic and correlation.

proposals.title: Odious Debt
proposals.angle: The legal doctrine arguing successor governments should not owe debts incurred by despotic regimes without public benefit.

proposals.title: Debt Exchange Offer
proposals.angle: The voluntary swap of existing sovereign bonds for new instruments with lower face value or extended maturities.

proposals.title: Notes to Financial Statements
proposals.angle: How footnote disclosures expand and qualify the numbers in the primary statements.

proposals.title: Proxy Statement
proposals.angle: The SEC filing that discloses executive pay, board votes, and related-party transactions to shareholders.

proposals.title: 10-Q
proposals.angle: The quarterly SEC filing that provides condensed unaudited financials between annual 10-K reports.

proposals.title: Earnings Per Share
proposals.angle: How basic and diluted EPS are calculated and why dilution from options and convertibles matters.

proposals.title: Statement of Retained Earnings
proposals.angle: The reconciliation of opening to closing retained earnings through net income and dividends.

proposals.title: Comparative Financial Statements
proposals.angle: The requirement to present prior-period figures alongside current results for trend analysis.

proposals.title: Interim Financial Statements
proposals.angle: The special recognition and measurement rules that apply when reporting for periods shorter than a full year.

proposals.title: Restatement of Financial Statements
proposals.angle: When and how a company corrects previously issued financials for errors or fraud discoveries.

proposals.title: Management Discussion and Analysis
proposals.angle: The MD&A section where executives explain results, liquidity, and forward-looking risks in narrative form.

proposals.title: Discontinued Operations Reporting
proposals.angle: How divested or held-for-sale business units are carved out and presented separately on the income statement.

proposals.title: Variable Interest Entity
proposals.angle: The consolidation rules that pull off-balance-sheet SPEs onto a sponsor's balance sheet under ASC 810.

proposals.title: Push-Down Accounting
proposals.angle: Revaluing an acquired subsidiary's standalone financial statements to reflect the acquirer's purchase price.

proposals.title: Noncontrolling Interest
proposals.angle: How the portion of a subsidiary not owned by the parent is presented in consolidated equity and earnings.

proposals.title: Functional Currency Translation
proposals.angle: How a subsidiary's foreign-currency financials are translated into the parent's reporting currency.

proposals.title: Prior Period Adjustment
proposals.angle: The retrospective correction of an accounting error directly to opening retained earnings, bypassing current income.

proposals.title: Special Purpose Vehicle Accounting
proposals.angle: The criteria governing when a sponsor must consolidate an SPV created to hold assets or transfer risk.

proposals.title: Related Party Transactions Disclosure
proposals.angle: Rules requiring companies to disclose deals with owners, executives, and affiliated entities in financial filings.

proposals.title: Heston Stochastic Volatility Model
proposals.angle: How the Heston model lets volatility itself follow a mean-reverting random process, fitting the volatility smile.

proposals.title: SABR Model
proposals.angle: The SABR model prices interest-rate options by making both forward price and volatility stochastic simultaneously.

proposals.title: Local Volatility Model
proposals.angle: Dupire's framework calibrates a deterministic vol surface so the model perfectly matches all observed option prices.

proposals.title: Black-76 Model
proposals.angle: Fischer Black's adaptation of Black-Scholes to price futures options and interest-rate caps and floors.

proposals.title: Bachelier Model
proposals.angle: The normal-distribution option pricing model, preferred for near-zero or negative underlying rates.

proposals.title: Jump-Diffusion Model
proposals.angle: Merton's extension of Black-Scholes that adds sudden price jumps to capture fat-tailed return distributions.

proposals.title: Variance Gamma Model
proposals.angle: A pure-jump Levy process option pricing model that independently controls skewness and excess kurtosis.

proposals.title: Constant Elasticity of Variance Model
proposals.angle: The CEV model links volatility inversely to stock price level, generating the observed leverage effect.

proposals.title: Trinomial Option Pricing
proposals.angle: The trinomial lattice adds a middle node at each step, improving convergence and handling American exercise.

proposals.title: Finite Difference Methods for Options
proposals.angle: Numerical PDE solvers — explicit, implicit, and Crank-Nicolson — that discretise the Black-Scholes equation on a grid.

proposals.title: Risk-Neutral Pricing
proposals.angle: The foundational theorem establishing that derivatives are priced by discounting expected payoffs under a risk-neutral measure.

proposals.title: Forward Measure
proposals.angle: How changing the numeraire to a zero-coupon bond simplifies interest-rate derivative pricing under the T-forward measure.

proposals.title: Bjerksund-Stensland Model
proposals.angle: An analytic approximation for American option pricing that avoids the full binomial lattice computational cost.

proposals.title: Barone-Adesi Whaley Model
proposals.angle: A quadratic approximation for American option fair value widely used by practitioners for its closed-form speed.

proposals.title: Volatility Surface Construction
proposals.angle: How traders build a consistent three-dimensional implied-volatility surface across strikes and expiries for pricing and hedging.

proposals.title: Stochastic Local Volatility Model
proposals.angle: A hybrid that blends local and stochastic volatility to match the smile while reproducing realistic forward dynamics.

proposals.title: Rough Volatility Model
proposals.angle: Gatheral's fractional Brownian motion framework, where volatility paths are rougher than standard diffusion implies.

proposals.title: Copula Pricing Model
proposals.angle: How copula functions model joint default or asset-return dependence to price basket and correlation derivatives.

proposals.title: LIBOR Market Model
proposals.angle: The Brace-Gatarek-Musiela framework that models forward LIBOR rates directly for cap, floor, and swaption pricing.

proposals.title: Hull-White Model
proposals.angle: A one-factor short-rate model with mean reversion that fits the initial yield curve for interest-rate derivatives.

proposals.title: Cox-Ingersoll-Ross Model
proposals.angle: The CIR model keeps interest rates non-negative through a square-root diffusion term for the short rate.

proposals.title: Displaced Diffusion Model
proposals.angle: A simple shift of the lognormal Black model that accommodates negative interest rates without switching to a full normal model.

proposals.title: Quanto Pricing
proposals.angle: How the correlation between an underlying asset and an exchange rate is incorporated into quanto derivative valuation.

proposals.title: Exotic Option Monte Carlo Simulation
proposals.angle: Path-dependent payoff estimation via simulation, covering variance reduction techniques such as antithetic variates and control variates.

proposals.title: Least-Squares Monte Carlo
proposals.angle: Longstaff-Schwartz regression-based method for valuing American and Bermudan options on simulated paths.

proposals.title: Ito's Lemma
proposals.angle: The stochastic calculus chain rule that underlies every derivative pricing PDE, including the Black-Scholes equation.

proposals.title: Girsanov's Theorem
proposals.angle: The probability-measure change that converts a real-world Brownian motion into a risk-neutral one for derivatives pricing.

proposals.title: Term Structure Models
proposals.angle: The taxonomy of short-rate versus HJM versus market models used to price instruments across the yield curve.

proposals.title: Basis Risk
proposals.angle: The residual risk when a hedge instrument does not move perfectly with the underlying exposure.

proposals.title: Macro Hedging

proposals.title: Cash Flow Hedge

proposals.title: Fair Value Hedge

proposals.title: Net Investment Hedge

proposals.title: Stack-and-Roll Hedge

proposals.title: Minimum Variance Hedge Ratio

proposals.title: Event-Driven Hedging

proposals.title: Correlation Hedging

proposals.title: Long-Short Hedge
